scripts.deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dev: opennextjs-cloudflare build && npm run db:migrate:dev && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.dev.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.dev.jsonc

DB.description: D1 database for forms, submissions, and users. Leave as **new** to create it automatically. **Second FormFlare in this account?** Rename it (for example `formflare-2`), or it silently shares the first install's data.

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for uploaded files. Leave as **new**.

JOBS.description: Queue for sending emails and webhooks in the background. Leave as **new**. **Second FormFlare in this account?** Rename it (for example `formflare-2-jobs`): a queue can feed only one Worker, so the default name fails the deploy.

EMAIL.description: Cloudflare Email Sending. Optional: owner alerts and auto-replies need Email Sending enabled, and sending to arbitrary recipients needs the **Workers Paid** plan. The app works without it.
